primary_subject.pose: Centered, sitting upright on a lavender-tinted siltstone, looking directly at the camera with a joyful, wide-eyed expression.

visual_elements.background: The lush Cedar Mountain flora (Paleopus and Conifers) slightly blurred (bokeh effect) to keep focus on the lizard.
